policy: No existing folders/assets may be changed or replaced.
No FBXs, meshes, maps, actors, lighting or gameplay are imported/modified by this helper.
Every image has an explicit TexCoord node with the recorded channel index.
OpenGL tangent normals import as NormalMap with green flipped for Unreal DirectX convention.

Only exact approved optical profiles receive translucent materials. Opaque labels/wood/stone stay opaque. Artistic optical opacity is not a physical transmission conversion. Unknown transmission/alpha/emission/subsurface/coat/other unsupported graphs block full apply. --allow-supported-subset explicitly creates only supported materials; unresolved slots stay listed.
Tangent normal maps require UV0. Strength in [0,1] uses normalize(lerp((0,0,1), decoded normal, strength)); other strengths are blocked.

Only the exact Warm opal diffuser and Cold opal diffuser names use reviewed opaque Unlit emission profiles; each multiplier is an artistic starting value, never a photometric conversion or light-creation instruction.
Actual Unreal API execution, shader compilation, render parity and save/reload require engine validation.
